a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two storm-free rounds before anyone takes. That gives each of us about a 4% chance. So I'm breaking the agreement and taking 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, or a random split likely leaves us both with 2. After I take, I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve back up. I won't take more than 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
